svg.text: First smoke of each team-game: Loop against Hotspot

Dot = a team's first smoke of the game (any ship). Cross = average position. Letters = ship (D Daring, S Somers, G Gearing, Gd Gdansk, N Napoli, Sh Shimakaze, H Harugumo, Sv Svea). Top 6 blue, Rest orange.
Loop: 41 first smokes, median 4:14, 32% by long-smoke ships
Hotspot: 62 first smokes, median 2:37, 65% by long-smoke ships
